def render_g_cost_by_carrier(pdf, dataframes, x, y, w, h):
    # Access the primary dataframe
    df = dataframes.get('shipment_quality.csv')
    if df is None or df.empty:
        return

    # --- Data preparation ---
    # Group by carrier and sum cost
    cost_by_carrier = df.groupby('carrier', as_index=False)['cost'].sum()
    # Sort descending for readability
    cost_by_carrier = cost_by_carrier.sort_values('cost', ascending=False)

    carriers = cost_by_carrier['carrier'].tolist()
    costs = cost_by_carrier['cost'].tolist()

    # --- Matplotlib figure ---
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(w / 25.4, h / 25.4), constrained_layout=True)

    # Colors for each carrier (professional palette)
    colors = ['#4c72b0', '#55a868', '#c44e52']  # blue, green, red

    bars = ax.bar(carriers, costs, color=colors[:len(carriers)], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)

    # Add value labels inside bars (white, small, centered)
    for bar, val in zip(bars, costs):
        ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2,
                bar.get_height() / 2,
                f'{val:,.0f}',
                ha='center', va='center',
                color='white', fontsize=7, fontweight='bold')

    # Title (internal to the image)
    ax.set_title('Custo Total por Transportadora', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', pad=8)

    # Format y-axis
    ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(plt.FuncFormatter(lambda x, _: f'{x:,.0f}'))
    ax.set_ylabel('Custo Total (R$)', fontsize=8)
    ax.set_xlabel('')  # no x-axis label because space is tight
    ax.tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=8)
    ax.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=7)

    # Adjust layout to avoid clipping

    # --- Save and insert into PDF ---

        plt.savefig(tmp.name, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.05)
        plt.close(fig)
        pdf.image(tmp.name, x=x, y=y, w=w, h=h)
        os.unlink(tmp.name)

def render_g_late_by_carrier(pdf, dataframes, x, y, w, h):
    # Get the primary dataframe
    df = dataframes.get('shipment_quality.csv')
    if df is None or df.empty:
        return

    # Compute average late percentage per carrier
    avg_late = df.groupby('carrier', as_index=False)['late_pct'].mean()
    # Sort descending for ranking (highest first)
    avg_late = avg_late.sort_values('late_pct', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)

    # Create the bar chart with matplotlib
    figsize_cm = (w / 25.4, h / 25.4)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize_cm)

    # Define colors for each carrier (distinct)
    colors = ['#4e79a7', '#f28e2b', '#e15759']
    bars = ax.bar(avg_late['carrier'], avg_late['late_pct'], color=colors[:len(avg_late)])

    # Labels and title (Portuguese)
    ax.set_xlabel('Transportadora', fontsize=9)
    ax.set_ylabel('Taxa de Atraso (%)', fontsize=9)
    ax.set_title('Taxa Média de Atraso por Transportadora', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', pad=8)

    # Add value labels on top of bars
    max_val = avg_late['late_pct'].max()
    ax.set_ylim(0, max_val * 1.25)  # reserve space for labels
    for i, bar in enumerate(bars):
        height = bar.get_height()
        ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2., height + 0.2,
                f'{height:.1f}%', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8)

    # Clean styling
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
    ax.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=8)
    plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')

    # Adjust layout to fit labels
    fig.subplots_adjust(bottom=0.28, top=0.88)

    # Save temporary image and insert into PDF
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".png", delete=False) as tmp:
        plt.savefig(tmp.name, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.05)
        plt.close(fig)
        pdf.image(tmp.name, x=x, y=y, w=w, h=h)
        os.unlink(tmp.name)

def render_g_late_damage_scatter(pdf, dataframes, x, y, w, h):
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Safety: retrieve primary dataframe
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    df = dataframes.get('shipment_quality.csv')
    if df is None or df.empty:
        # Empty placeholder
        pdf.set_xy(x, y)
        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", size=8)
        pdf.cell(w, h, "Dados insuficientes para o gráfico de dispersão.", align="C")
        return

    required_cols = ['late_pct', 'damage_pct', 'warehouse', 'carrier']
    for col in required_cols:
        if col not in df.columns:
            # skip if column missing
            pdf.set_xy(x, y)
            pdf.set_font("Helvetica", size=8)
            pdf.cell(w, h, f"Coluna '{col}' não encontrada.", align="C")
            return

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Prepare palette for warehouses (max 3)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    warehouse_colors = {
        w: color for w, color in zip(
            sorted(df['warehouse'].unique()),
            ['#1f77b4', '#ff7f0e', '#2ca02c']   # up to 3 warehouses
        )
    }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Build scatter with annotations
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(w / 25.4, h / 25.4))

    for _, row in df.iterrows():
        color = warehouse_colors.get(row['warehouse'], '#888888')
        ax.scatter(
            row['late_pct'], row['damage_pct'],
            s=80,        # marker size
            c=color,
            edgecolors='black',
            linewidth=0.5,
            zorder=5
        )
        # Label each point: "Warehouse Carrier"
        label = f"{row['warehouse']}-{row['carrier']}"
        # Offset text slightly to avoid overlapping markers
        ax.annotate(
            label,
            xy=(row['late_pct'], row['damage_pct']),
            xytext=(5, 5),              # offset in points
            textcoords="offset points",
            fontsize=6,
            fontweight='bold',
            color='#333333',
            alpha=0.85
        )

    ax.set_xlabel('% Atraso (late_pct)', fontsize=8)
    ax.set_ylabel('% Danos (damage_pct)', fontsize=8)
    ax.set_title('Relação entre Atraso e Danos (por observação)', fontsize=9, pad=8)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Legend (outside right) – one entry per warehouse
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    handles = [
        plt.Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markersize=6,
                   markerfacecolor=color, label=wh)
        for wh, color in warehouse_colors.items()
    ]
    legend = ax.legend(
        handles=handles,
        loc='upper left',
        bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 0.98),
        frameon=False,
        fontsize=7,
        title='Armazém',
        title_fontsize=7
    )
    # Reserve right margin for legend
    fig.subplots_adjust(right=0.78)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save and embed
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    import tempfile, os
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".png", delete=False) as tmp:
        plt.savefig(tmp.name, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.05)
        plt.close()
        pdf.image(tmp.name, x=x, y=y, w=w, h=h)
        os.unlink(tmp.name)

import os
os.environ.setdefault('MPLCONFIGDIR', '/tmp/matplotlib')
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from fpdf import FPDF, XPos, YPos
import tempfile
import textwrap

sns.set_theme(style='whitegrid')

def _safe_pdf_text(value):
    replacements = {
        '\u2013': '-', '\u2014': '-', '\u2015': '-',
        '\u2018': "'", '\u2019': "'", '\u201c': '"', '\u201d': '"',
        '\u2022': '-', '\u00a0': ' ', '\u2026': '...'
    }
    text = str(value or '')
    for source, target in replacements.items():
        text = text.replace(source, target)
    return text.encode('latin-1', 'replace').decode('latin-1')

def _wrap_lines(text, max_chars):
    lines = []
    for paragraph in str(text).splitlines() or ['']:
        wrapped = textwrap.wrap(paragraph.strip(), width=max_chars) or ['']
        lines.extend(wrapped)
    return lines

def _sentence_chunks(text):
    normalized = ' '.join(str(text).split())
    chunks, current = [], []
    for token in normalized.split(' '):
        current.append(token)
        if token.rstrip().endswith(('.', '!', '?', ';')):
            chunks.append(' '.join(current))
            current = []
    if current:
        chunks.append(' '.join(current))
    return chunks or [normalized]

def _fit_text_to_box(text, w, h, font_size, line_height):
    max_chars = max(14, int(w * 0.55 * (10 / max(font_size, 1))))
    max_lines = max(1, int(h / max(line_height, 1)))
    if len(_wrap_lines(text, max_chars)) <= max_lines:
        return text
    selected = []
    for sentence in _sentence_chunks(text):
        candidate = ' '.join(selected + [sentence]).strip()
        if not candidate:
            continue
        if len(_wrap_lines(candidate, max_chars)) <= max_lines:
            selected.append(sentence)
        elif selected:
            break
        else:
            words = sentence.split()
            compact = []
            for word in words:
                candidate = ' '.join(compact + [word])
                if len(_wrap_lines(candidate, max_chars)) > max_lines:
                    break
                compact.append(word)
            selected.append(' '.join(compact))
            break
    fitted = ' '.join(selected).strip()
    return fitted

def _write_report_title(pdf, title, font_family):
    clean_title = ' '.join(_safe_pdf_text(title or 'Relatório Analítico').split())
    for size in range(16, 10, -1):
        max_chars = max(28, int(58 * (16 / size)))
        lines = textwrap.wrap(clean_title, width=max_chars) or [clean_title]
        if len(lines) <= 2:
            pdf.set_font(font_family, 'B', size)
            pdf.multi_cell(0, 8, '\n'.join(lines), new_x=XPos.LMARGIN, new_y=YPos.NEXT, align='C')
            return
    pdf.set_font(font_family, 'B', 11)
    pdf.multi_cell(0, 7, '\n'.join(textwrap.wrap(clean_title, width=84)), new_x=XPos.LMARGIN, new_y=YPos.NEXT, align='C')

def render_text_block(pdf, text, x, y, w, h, title=None):
    font_size = 10
    line_height = 5
    text = _safe_pdf_text(text)
    title = _safe_pdf_text(title) if title else None
    body_height = h
    pdf.set_xy(x, y)
    if title:
        pdf.set_font('helvetica', 'B', font_size)
        pdf.cell(w, 7, title, new_x=XPos.LMARGIN, new_y=YPos.NEXT)
        body_height = max(1, h - 8)
        pdf.set_xy(x, pdf.get_y())
    
    fitted_text = _fit_text_to_box(text, w, body_height, font_size, line_height)
    pdf.set_font('helvetica', '', font_size)
    pdf.multi_cell(w, line_height, fitted_text, align='J')

        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", size=8)
        pdf.cell(w, h, "Dados insuficientes para o gráfico de dispersão.", align="C")
        return

    required_cols = ['late_pct', 'damage_pct', 'warehouse', 'carrier']
    for col in required_cols:
        if col not in df.columns:
            # skip if column missing
            pdf.set_xy(x, y)
            pdf.set_font("Helvetica", size=8)
            pdf.cell(w, h, f"Coluna '{col}' não encontrada.", align="C")
            return

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Prepare palette for warehouses (max 3)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    warehouse_colors = {
        w: color for w, color in zip(
            sorted(df['warehouse'].unique()),
            ['#1f77b4', '#ff7f0e', '#2ca02c']   # up to 3 warehouses
        )
    }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Build scatter with annotations
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(w / 25.4, h / 25.4))

    for _, row in df.iterrows():
        color = warehouse_colors.get(row['warehouse'], '#888888')
        ax.scatter(
            row['late_pct'], row['damage_pct'],
            s=80,        # marker size
            c=color,
            edgecolors='black',
            linewidth=0.5,
            zorder=5
        )
        # Label each point: "Warehouse Carrier"
        label = f"{row['warehouse']}-{row['carrier']}"
        # Offset text slightly to avoid overlapping markers
        ax.annotate(
            label,
            xy=(row['late_pct'], row['damage_pct']),
            xytext=(5, 5),              # offset in points
            textcoords="offset points",
            fontsize=6,
            fontweight='bold',
            color='#333333',
            alpha=0.85
        )

    ax.set_xlabel('% Atraso (late_pct)', fontsize=8)
    ax.set_ylabel('% Danos (damage_pct)', fontsize=8)
    ax.set_title('Relação entre Atraso e Danos (por observação)', fontsize=9, pad=8)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Legend (outside right) – one entry per warehouse
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    handles = [
        plt.Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markersize=6,
                   markerfacecolor=color, label=wh)
        for wh, color in warehouse_colors.items()
    ]
    legend = ax.legend(
        handles=handles,
        loc='upper left',
        bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 0.98),
        frameon=False,
        fontsize=7,
        title='Armazém',
        title_fontsize=7
    )
    # Reserve right margin for legend
    fig.subplots_adjust(right=0.78)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save and embed
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    import tempfile, os
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".png", delete=False) as tmp:
        plt.savefig(tmp.name, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.05)
        plt.close()
        pdf.image(tmp.name, x=x, y=y, w=w, h=h)
        os.unlink(tmp.name)
